mount-options.statement: Mounting options: ZT400 rack posts via rack mount kit (by request only); ZT600 rack posts via rack mount kit; ZT800 rack posts via rack mount kit or wall via wall mount kit (wall kit by request only); ZT8010 rack posts via ear brackets.

quotes: - The Zero Trust Branch ZT400: Rack posts using the rack mount kit. (Only available by request.)
- The Zero Trust Branch ZT600: Rack posts using the rack mount kit.

- The Zero Trust Branch ZT800:
  - Rack posts using the rack mount kit.
  - To the wall, using the wall mount kit. (Only available by request.)
- The Zero Trust Branch ZT8010: Rack posts using the ear brackets.

power-specs.statement: Typical power: ZT400 12W idle/20W full load, ZT600 21W/29W, ZT800 24W/43W, ZT8010 107.8W/225.5W.

quotes: | Typical Power Consumption | Idle Mode: 12W Full Load Mode: 20W | Idle Mode: 21W Full Load Mode: 29W | Idle Mode: 24W Full Load Mode: 43W | Idle Mode: 107.8W Full Load Mode: 225.5W |

zt8010-psu-alarm.statement: On the ZT8010, a continuous beep indicates the second power source is unplugged or faulty; pressing the round button near the power supplies silences it, as does connecting the second power source.

quotes: A continuous beep indicates that either the second power source is unplugged or faulty. To silence the beep, press the round button located near or between the power supplies, or connect the second power source.

zt8010-ports.statement: The ZT8010 has several ports, including 10x 1GbE RJ45 ports and 8x 10G SFP+ ports, and supports redundant PSUs.

The appliance supports redundant power supply units (PSUs).

specs-table-merged-cells.title: Which models other than the ZT8010 have the redundant power supply and fan, and the maximum power of the ZT400 and ZT600
specs-table-merged-cells.detail: The per-model specification table on the mount instruction page has merged cells, so the redundant power supply and fan rows and the maximum power for ZT400 and ZT600 cannot be assigned to a model from the captured text; they are not claimed. The ZT8010 redundant PSUs come from the ZT8010 procedure's own text, not the table.

deployment-table-vs-port-mapping.title: Why the deployment page's interface table and the port mapping name some ports differently
deployment-table-vs-port-mapping.detail: The deployment page's HA interface table lists GE2 under both LAN and WAN for the ZT600 and no GE6, while the port mapping lists GE2 as LAN and GE5 and GE6 as WAN. For the ZT8010 it names XE11 to XE14 as LAN interfaces, while the port mapping names GE11 to GE14 as 1GbE RJ45 LAN and XE15 to XE18 as 10G SFP+ LAN. The table also marks GE5 as the fixed WAN port of the ZT600 and lists GE5 as a LAN port of the ZT800, while the port mapping lists GE5 as WAN on the ZT600 and LAN on the ZT800 without saying whether either is fixed or reserved for an HA transit link. The pages do not say whether the table shows template defaults or a different naming.
